# Original caption vectors

Created by Bondline contributors2026-11-17, MIT OR Apache-2.0. These are independently
authored XML, not proprietary exports, examples, templates or assets.

`explicit.cdxml` follows the public SDK Text/Style/2DPosition/ColorTable specifications
recorded in docs/research/styled-captions.md. It requests the already licensed bundled
Roboto Regular family by logical name; it contains no font data. Explicit styles,
baseline and white palette background avoid undocumented last-used defaults.
